EscalationRequest.description:
Hand off to a human or higher authority, or ask for help while continuing.
``urgency`` is authoritative; ``blocking`` is a deprecated read-only alias for ``urgency == "blocked"``.

context.description: Structured context the recipient needs to decide (relevant state, options).
context.title: Context

reason.description: Why escalation is needed — the blocker, uncertainty, or decision beyond your authority.
reason.title: Reason

urgency.description: 'fyi': soft — you are continuing, this is informational (a help signal). 'blocked': hard — you cannot proceed until this is resolved (the default, matching the historical 'blocking=True' behavior).
urgency.title: Urgency

EscalationRequest.title: EscalationRequest

SpawnRequest.description: Request to add a new operation to the running workflow.

assignee.description: Role to execute it (researcher, implementer, critic, ...). Omit to reuse the emitter's own role/branch.
assignee.title: Assignee

independent.description: If true the new op starts immediately with no dependency on you. If false (default) it runs after you and inherits your output as context.
independent.title: Independent

instruction.description: The new unit of work, stated as a concrete, self-contained objective.
instruction.title: Instruction

operation.description: lionagi operation to run: operate | chat | communicate | ReAct. Default operate.
operation.title: Operation

reason.description: Why this work is needed now and why it fell outside the original plan.
reason.title: Reason
